mapper.sql: id,protocol,actor_member_id as actorMemberId,request_id as requestId,scope_key as scopeKey, payload_sha256 as payloadSha256,state,result_json as resultJson,error_code as errorCode,error_message as errorMessage, create_time as createTime,update_time as updateTime
mapper.select: select from app_original_request where protocol=#{protocol} and actor_member_id=#{actor} and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.update: update app_original_request set state=#{state},result_json=#{resultJson},error_code=#{errorCode}, error_message=#{errorMessage},update_time=now(3) where id=#{id} and state='RUNNING'
